NITA Hospital.err: Smallest named building (358 m2); imagery shows a health-centre scale block, 2 storeys assumed.

ECE Building.err: 7 storeys taken from OSM levels=7 corroborated by an annual-report 'G+6' reference; the storey height is assumed 3.4 m.

Visvesvaraya Auditorium.note: OSM height=12 m; single tall hall volume with a balcony, deep roof, portico on the road side
Visvesvaraya Auditorium.err: Single hall volume with a hip roof; the portico position is a guess from the plan.

Arybhatta Hostel.note: OSM building:levels=3; U-shaped plan, pitched red-tile roofs in imagery
Arybhatta Hostel.err: U-plan is right but the roof is rendered pitched; one researcher reads a flat slab roof from imagery. Unresolved.

Gargi Girls Hostel.note: OSM levels=15 rejected as implausible (a 15-storey block is 52 m); 3 bands in imagery
Gargi Girls Hostel.err: OSM maps the whole hostel group as one polygon, so the render is a single large pitched mass instead of the 3-4 separate red-roofed blocks visible in imagery; OSM building:levels=15 rejected.

Monty Xerox.err: OSM height=2 has no unit and is impossible as metres; treated as 2 storeys.

NIT Agartala.note: main academic cluster; 3 storeys (ESTIMATED from footprint and imagery); parallel wings with pitched red roofs
NIT Agartala.err: Name refers to the institution, not a building; built as the main academic cluster (relation 5385967 'Mechanical Department' has this way as its outer ring). Storey count is an estimate.

Chemical Department.note: 2 storeys per two independent researchers; 33rd BWC places some Chemical rooms in a separate new academic building
Chemical Department.err: Two storeys per two independent reviewers; the department is split across buildings, so this footprint is only part of it.

CSE Department.err: 4 storeys from OSM height 15.20 m; the two-bar angled plan is reproduced from the OSM outline.

Library.note: octagonal plan; central raised drum visible as a bright disc in imagery
Library.err: Octagonal plan and central drum are clear in imagery; the number of glazing bands on the drum is decorative.

Civil Building.err: Height 20 m is an OSM tag of unknown provenance; the 5-storey interpretation assumes 4.0 m storeys.

Academic Block 1.note: 4 window bands counted in Esri imagery; long 34x66 m slab, long axis N-S
Academic Block 1.err: Footprint and 4 storeys are solid; window rhythm and roof equipment are stylised.

Academic Block 2.note: 3 window bands; O-shaped plan with inner court visible in imagery
Academic Block 2.err: 3 storeys estimated; the inner courtyard is subtracted from the footprint.

CSE Canteen.err: 34 m2 footprint; OSM geometry is barely larger than one block, so the render is a kiosk.

New Auditorium.note: OSM height=15 m; large-span shell roof, green in imagery
New Auditorium.err: Shell roof modelled as a shallow barrel vault; real roof form is not clearly readable at 0.55 m/px.

RNT Mess.note: OSM height=15 m over a 97x52 m curved plan; 2 tall storeys
RNT Mess.err: The curved 97x52 m plan is reproduced; the roof is rendered flat, real form unknown.

Guest House.note: 3 bands; low hip roof with red tiles in imagery
Guest House.err: Long slab confirmed; internal room layout and the 48-room count are out of scope.

Shopping Complex.note: OSM height=12 m; circular market with radial roof segments and a ring arcade
Shopping Complex.err: Circular market confirmed; the radial stall roofs in the render are a stylisation of the ring of stalls visible in imagery.
